Name: CP Farm Registrar
Author: tbonehunter
Description: Detects Content Patcher farm mods which silently replace vanilla farm maps, and registers them as proper selectable farm types in the character creation screen, giving the player the ability to select either the vanilla or the modded replacement farm without changing mod folder selections or configurations. See README in Documentation section for complete explanation and instructions for use, or download the README.md file from [url=https://github.com/tbonehunter/CPFarmRegistrar/blob/master/docs/README.md]https://github.com/tbonehunter/CPFarmRegistrar/blob/master/docs/README.md[/url]

Downloads.Description: v 1.1.0 adds ability to load previously saved games with the modded farm map rather than vanilla.

Manifest.Name: CP Farm Registrar
